title: weigela sanguinea var. leucantha
intro: Weigela sanguinea var. leucantha, commonly known as White Weigela, is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia and part of the Weigela family (Caprifoliaceae). It is known for its white, trumpet-shaped flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. Bioactive constituents of White Weigela include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, although further research is necessary to confirm the therapeutic actions and health benefits of the plant.
